title: About Auto Crónica
lead: My name's Daniel Fonseca da Silva. I'm a software engineer based in Portugal nearly nine years spent building reliable systems, from the cloud to the products people use every day and I'm also a car enthusiast. Auto Crónica came out of where those two things meet.
photoAlt: Portrait of Daniel Fonseca da Silva
problemBody: Anywhere in Europe, buying a car new or used often means going in blind. Every vehicle has faults that surface sooner or later: a part that always fails in the same place, an engine with a known weakness, a gearbox that gives trouble past a certain mileage. That information exists, but it's scattered across forums, groups and loose conversations and it's hard to know what to trust.
solutionBody: Auto Crónica is a catalogue of chronic faults organised by make and model, built to grow over time. When there isn't enough data yet on a vehicle, AI helps suggest the most likely issues; and a community of owners comments, corrects and votes on reports, so the information keeps getting more reliable.
communityBody: This project is for anyone who loves practical city cars, quiet electrics, characterful classics or sporty machines and wants to decide with more information and fewer surprises.
ctaHint: Start by searching for the make and model you have in mind.
